name: Team Pulse
summary: Projects, tasks, chat, files and a light CRM pipeline in one tool. The listed rates assume annual billing.
best_for: solo operators and small teams who want projects, tasks, chat AND a lightweight CRM pipeline with AI in one simple tool, and value the real free tier to start
skip_if: you need more than a handful of team members (seat caps climb the tiers fast), or you only need project management: dedicated PM tools give far more generous member limits
honest_knock: The tiers gate on TWO axes at once (member count and project/pipeline count) so you can hit a wall on either. The CRM pipeline is a big part of the pitch, but it doesn't exist below the $79 Growth plan (Free and Starter have none), and member limits are tight: Starter is a single seat, Growth just three. The headline rates are the annual ones; month-to-month costs 25 to 34% more ($39 against $29 on Starter, $99 against $79 on Growth).

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-13 in the site's own plan-config array; goteampulse.io/pricing itself returns 404, the plans sit on the home page) Genuinely free tier: $0/mo for 1 member, 2 projects, unlimited collaborators, chat/tasks/files, 3 private notes, 15 AI credits and 1GB storage. The paid tiers now publish both rates. Starter $39/mo monthly or $29/mo annually ($348/yr) — 1 member, 5 projects, NO pipelines; Growth $99 or $79 ($948/yr) — 3 members, 10 projects, 1 pipeline, AI Assist and AI workflow generation; Pro $199 or $159 ($1,908/yr) — 10 members, 20 projects, 2 pipelines; Scale $379 or $299 ($3,588/yr) — 40 projects, 4 pipelines, 1,500 AI credits, and no member count published. Paying monthly costs 34% more on Starter and 25-27% more on the rest. The terms page offers a 14-day free trial to new registrants, after which the subscription is suspended until it is upgraded to a paid plan.

exit_test.what: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. On 13 November 2026 the session tested Team Pulse on the Free plan: an AI generated project board. Blocked part: the Growth trial goes through a Stripe step that asks for payment details, so it was not continued and no card details were entered. The Pipeline tab, the pipeline feature and anything else behind the Growth trial are therefore not tested. Project Client onboarding Q4 was created with the description Onboard three new freelance clients: kickoff call, contract, first invoice, weekly check-in. Generate with AI returned five columns after about 10 seconds: Contracting & Legal, Kickoff & Strategy, Initial Billing, Weekly Check-ins and Fully Onboarded. Generate starter tasks returned five tasks after about 10 seconds, for example Draft and send master service agreements (MSAs) to all three clients. Create Project then showed Workflow created and a board with five columns and five tasks, with tabs Overview, Chat, Tasks, Files and Activity. The whole run took about 1 minute, was free and needed no card. Each AI generation costs 1 AI credit; the credit balance was not read. Tracking clients and tasks together in a pipeline was not tested because of the Stripe block. Inviting teammates on Free opens the Growth trial window, and Growth lists 3 team members; teams of more than three people were not tested. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Inviting a teammate on Free opens the Growth trial window instead of an invite form, and that window lists 1 pipeline for Growth while naming Pipelines as Available in Pro.

sessions.what: We ran Team Pulse's AI project builder on the Free plan on 13 November 2026, then followed the Growth trial window up to its payment step. The account is Daan's, and our AI assistant did the clicking. We stopped at the Stripe step that asks for payment details and entered no card. The Pipeline feature sits behind that trial, so we did not test it.
findings: We created a project called 'Client onboarding Q4' with the description 'Onboard three new freelance clients: kickoff call, contract, first invoice, weekly check-in'. The AI step took about 10 seconds and proposed five columns that run from contracting and legal through kickoff and billing to a fully onboarded client.

The starter-task step returned five tasks in about 10 seconds, the first one a draft of service agreements for all three clients. Creating the project then gave a board with five columns and five tasks, and the tabs Overview, Chat, Tasks, Files and Activity. The whole run took about a minute (our approximate timing), was free and needed no card.
Each AI generation costs 1 AI credit. We did not read the credit balance, so we cannot say how many generations Free allows.
The Pipeline tab was locked on Free. Inviting a teammate on Free did not open an invite form. It opened the Growth trial window, which lists 3 team members for Growth.
The same window lists 1 pipeline for Growth and also names Pipelines as 'Available in Pro'. We did not continue the trial, so we do not know whether Growth includes a working pipeline.

The window shows Growth at $79 a month billed annually ($948 a year) and a 'Founder Launch Offer' to lock in the current price for life while the subscription stays active. We did not see monthly billing, tax or the Pro price, and bought nothing, so the lock-in and the payable total are unknown.
not_tested: Sign-up on a fresh account (we joined an existing one)
The Pipeline feature and the Growth trial, which needs payment details at a Stripe step
Teams above three people, what Pro costs, and how many AI credits are left
Checkout, support, export, roles, API use, downgrade and cancelling
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
